name: parakeet-unified base, no bias, on clean_eval_v2
short_description: Per-clip STT predictions from the unmodified HuggingFace parakeet-unified-en-0.6b checkpoint, malsd_batch decoding, no GPU-PB boosting tree, on the 91-clip clean_eval_v2 holdout. Arm A of the t0026 2x2 biasing x fine-tuning ablation.
model_description: nvidia/parakeet-unified-en-0.6b, HuggingFace pretrained checkpoint, no local model asset. No fine-tuning and no context biasing were applied: decoding used malsd_batch with the boosting tree disabled (apply_malsd_no_boost), so this is the unmodified base model's transcription behavior.
prediction_schema: Each line is a JSON object with fields: clip_id (string, unique clip identifier), ref (string, ground-truth reference transcript), hyp (string, model hypothesis transcript, empty string on decode failure), brand (string "Rezolve" or "brainpowa", or null if the reference contains no target brand), label (string "EXACT"/"PHONETIC"/"GARBAGE" describing how the brand appears in hyp, or null when brand is null), wer (float, word error rate for this clip, 0.0-1.0+), latency_seconds (float, arm-average per-item inference time, not a true per-clip measurement), source (string "quepasa_prod" or "clean_eval_21", provenance of the clip).

files.description: Per-clip predictions for all 91 clean_eval_v2 clips (43 brand-containing: 40 Rezolve + 3 brainpowa; 48 neutral) from the base parakeet-unified model with no boosting tree, arm A of the t0026 ablation.
